name: mintlify
description: Mintlify docs: .md and .mdx content, ATX '#' headers, snippet includes (<Snippet file="foo.mdx" />) and MDX imports (import X from "/snippets/foo.mdx", used as <X />) resolved as paths under snippets/ or _snippets/ at the project root; .jsx/.js/.css imports are deliberately skipped. Auto-detected from a docs.json (current) or mint.json (legacy) file whose contents look like a Mintlify config, at or above content_dir, searching no further than the enclosing git repository.
